_doc: Everything about this paper that the page shows as data. mk_paper.py turns it into the headline card, Further reading and window.PAPER.
title: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec): A Sandbox Infrastructure for Effective Agentic Training at Scale
authors: Jialiang Huang (first author), Hongxuan Tang, Jingchang Chen, Yuxuan Liu and 126 more, with Mingxing Zhang, Liyue Zhang (corresponding), Panpan Huang and Wenfeng Liang: 131 authors, 16 of them marked as the DSec project developers

code.title: kvcache-ai/AgentENV, storage/overlaybd
code.note: the only code the paper releases: its Rust OverlayBD and ublk block-storage path for Firecracker microVMs (MIT licence), inside another group's platform. DSec itself, libdsec and the RL integration are not released

takeaway: The sandbox layer under agentic reinforcement learning, published with production numbers for the first time: four isolation levels behind one SDK, about 3 million sandboxes a day and 5,000 created per second on roughly 160 nodes, co-designed so stateful rollouts survive preemptible GPU training.
verdict: Believe the workload study and the four storage, memory and CPU mechanisms: their figures decode back to the text's numbers within a few percent. Treat the production scale as self-reported (no trace, no method) and the RL co-design, the paper's most original part, as described rather than measured: the evaluation leaves it out by design.
